jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

jobs.occupation: Project Support Officer - SAP & Document Control
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

For a project engineering team in Olen, we are looking for a well-organised Project Administrative Assistant / Project Support Officer to provide day-to-day administrative support in a technical project environment.

This role is focused on operational project administration, with emphasis on purchasing support, SAP follow-up, time registration processing, document control and coordination with internal stakeholders and external EPCM partners. The position is primarily administrative and does not require an engineering background.

• Follow up purchasing activities, purchase orders and invoices in SAP and SAP Ariba.
• Verify timecards and process time registrations in SAP for project staff and external partners.
• Coordinate administrative activities with internal teams and EPCM partners.
• Manage project documentation, including As Built files, folder structures and information flows.
• Prepare planning overviews, monitor action lists and follow up on missing input.
• Collect, register, analyse and verify project-related information in systems such as SAP and Planisware.
• Support the project team with meetings, minutes, communication, travel arrangements and backup administrative assistance.
Location

The assignment is based on site in Olen.

Full on-site presence is required during onboarding and training to become familiar with the team, systems and internal processes. After a successful onboarding period, remote work may be possible in agreement with the manager.

• You have at least 5 years of relevant experience in administrative support, project administration, purchasing support or project support.
• You have experience working in a technical project environment.
• You understand purchase orders, invoices, approval flows and administrative processes in practice.
• You have experience with Document Management Systems; knowledge of SharePoint is a strong plus.
• You are comfortable with Microsoft Office, especially Outlook, SharePoint, Word and Excel.
• Experience with SAP is a strong advantage; SAP Ariba is a plus.
• You work accurately with administrative data, time registrations, purchase-order information and invoice details.
• You are practical, hands-on and service-oriented.
• You are well organised and able to handle multiple administrative priorities at the same time.
• You are detail-oriented, reliable and attentive to project priorities.
• You take ownership and follow up tasks until completion.
• You proactively request missing input, monitor actions and escalate when needed.
• You communicate clearly and professionally with internal and external stakeholders.
• You feel comfortable in an international, multidisciplinary project environment.
• You are a team player who can also work independently within agreed procedures.
• Experience working according to documented procedures, approval workflows and audit-trail requirements is considered an asset.
• You are fluent in Dutch, both spoken and written.
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.

jobs.occupation: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

jobs.occupation: Store Assistant / Sales Associate – Christmas Shop | Bruges | Full-Time
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

For a unique Christmas store in the heart of Bruges, we are looking for an enthusiastic Store Assistant / Sales Associate who will help customers bring the Christmas spirit into their homes.

What will you do?
As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
• Processing payments and handling cash register duties
• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule
• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage
• You speak Spanish, Dutch or English fluently
• In addition to your strongest language, you can communicate at a basic level in at least one of the other languages
• You enjoy working in an international environment with tourists and visitors from different countries
• You are enthusiastic, reliable and enjoy working as part of a team

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

jobs.occupation: Talencia Consulting - BI Manager - Top Employer
jobs.description:
Talencia is looking for a Business Intelligence Manager for one of its clients.

Location : Herstal (Liège)

Start date : ASAP

Duration : Full-time Open-Ended Contract (CDI)
Context 

For one ou my close partner, I'm currently recruiting for a Business Intelligence Manager position within a large Belgian organisation undergoing an important Data & BI transformation.

The role combines people management, BI strategy and hands-on involvement in the evolution of the organisation's Data & BI landscape
Description

• Lead and develop a team of BI professionals (circ. 5 people)

• Define and implement the BI roadmap and strategy

• Contribute to Data Governance, Data Quality and Data Management

• You will be directly reporting the the current Head of Data

What's in for you

• Between 5.000EUR and 8.000EUR GR./mo (with at least an extra 150EUR of NET allowance)

• Company car (electric) with charging card

• Health and group insurance

• Up to 30 days of paid holidays

• Hybrid work model with 3 days remote

• Various bonuses and sectorial benefits

 

The position offers the opportunity to have a significant strategic impact on the organisation's Data & BI landscape, while managing a dedicated team.

In case of interest in this job, please send us your updated resume.

• 7+ years of experience in Business Intelligence / Data

• Strong knowledge of Power BI, SAP BusinessObjects and SQL

• Good understanding of Data Warehousing / Data Architecture

• Experience with Data Governance and Data Quality

• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication and change management skills

• Fluent in Dutch and/or French, with good knowledge of English

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

This company moves over 250 orders a day from  730 suppliers in EAME to over 72 facilities all over the world.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have a bachelor’s degree? Are you an analytical thinker with strong communication skills? Can you express yourself clearly, both orally and in writing, in English and Dutch? If so, you could be the Junior Logistics Planning Analyst we’re looking for!

Within the Global Parts Supply (GPS) team, working with suppliers is key. As a GPS team member, you are the vital link between suppliers and customers, managing all supplier communications. The mission is to maintain a healthy supply chain and prevent shortages that could lead to customer back orders. On a daily basis, you liaise with suppliers, drive accountability for their results, and work toward challenging but achievable goals that ensure superior service levels.

As a Logistics Planning Analyst, you are responsible to establish solid business relationships with a set of defined suppliers: 

• Focus on timely and quality deliveries to the distribution center, ensuring parts are available for the end customer.
• Educate and hold suppliers accountable to achieve challenging business results.
• Value teamwork and collaborate with key partners such as transportation, procurement, and engineering as needed.
• To be successful, you will need to develop and master a thorough understanding of our supply chain processes and systems.
Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

• Monitor schedules to ensure punctual and efficient shipments with suppliers.
• Track supplier performance and implement corrective actions when necessary.
• Maintain strong communication and positive relationships with both internal divisions and external suppliers.
• Evaluate and challenge supplier results based on the supplier performance standard.
• Analyze and correct data irregularities.
• Provide thorough support on high priority back orders.

The Junior Logistics Planning Analyst we are looking for has the following skills:

• Minimum Master’s degree with a strong link to Supply Chain, Logistics Management, Production, and Logistics or Transport.
• Strong attention to detail.
• Analytical mindset.
• Fluent written and oral skills in English and Dutch are required, French or German is a plus.
• Motivated to work in a target focused area.
• Self-motivated and committed.
• Strong interpersonal skills.
